`echo "/tmp/malicious.so" > /etc/ld.so.preload` would:

1. **`/etc/ld.so.preload`** — This file tells the Linux dynamic linker to **preload specified shared libraries into every process** before any other libraries.

2. **Effect** — Every program executed on the system would load `/tmp/malicious.so` first, allowing it to:
   - **Hook/intercept any system call** (passwords, file I/O, network traffic)
   - **Backdoor every executable** on the system
   - **Escalate privileges** or maintain persistent access
   - **Hide malware** (rootkit behavior)

3. **This is a classic rootkit installation technique.**
